newsitem.title: USA: Pennzoil to drill five intl wells this year.
newsitem.headline: Pennzoil to drill five intl wells this year.

text.p: Pennzoil Co said in a statement with earnings that it will drill five international wells this year.
In Azerbaijan, Pennzoil, Russia's LUKoil and Italy's AGIP, plan to spud the first exploration well on the Karabakh structure offshore Baku in August.
In Qatar, Pennzoil will drill two exploration wells on Block 8 and an exploration well in southwestern Australia on the Whicher Range concession.

In Egypt, Pennzoil and Spain's Repsol drilled an unsuccessful exploration well on the Southeast Gulf of Suez block during the second quarter. Pennzoil's share of the dry hole expense associated with the well totaled $3 million on a pre-tax basis.
The two companies are evaluating three additional drill locations on the Southeast Gulf of Suez block.

The company said that it also took a one time charge of $11.7 million in its second quarter earnings from the sale of a natural gas marketing unit, the retirement of debt and its defence of a hostile bid from Union Pacific Resources Group Inc. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
